chunks.text: Paris is the capital and most populous city of France, on the river Seine.
France is a country in Western Europe; its capital city is Paris.
Berlin is the capital of Germany and its largest city.
The Seine is a river in northern France flowing through Paris.
Madrid is the capital of Spain, located on the Manzanares river.
Mont Blanc is the highest mountain in the Alps, on the French-Italian border.
Rome is the capital of Italy, on the river Tiber.
